sections.title: Digital Transformation
sections.subtitle: Modernise applications, automate operations and connect every channel your customers use.

sections.heading: Digital transformation for your next stage
sections.body:
Modernise legacy applications, automate work and connect customer channels, with quality and security built into delivery. Linkworks supports composable applications and integration; testoriumz supports continuous testing and release assurance.

Start with the application, process or customer journey that needs to change. [Talk to us about your modernisation requirements](#get-in-touch).

sections.heading: What we deliver
sections.description: Choose the specialist service that fits your next decision.

items.title: App modernisation
items.description: Change legacy applications without losing sight of business workflows. Scope cloud engineering, DevOps and microservices around the systems that need to evolve.

items.title: Automation & RPA
items.description: Reduce repetitive work through UiPath, Blue Prism and AI workflows. Connect software bots, applications and the people who handle exceptions.

items.title: Integration services
items.description: Connect applications, data and processes across the enterprise. Deliver APIs, Boomi integrations and application interfaces with clear ownership.

items.title: WhatsApp Business & omnichannel
items.description: Connect customer conversations and business workflows across WhatsApp and other channels. Support conversational service, commerce and connected customer journeys.

items.title: Quality engineering
items.description: Make change testable through automation, continuous quality engineering and AI code assurance. Integrate testing and release evidence into CI/CD.

items.title: Cloud services
items.description: Modernise, migrate and optimise enterprise cloud environments. Combine cloud engineering, DevOps and automation with application and operational requirements.

sections.heading: Assure change. Improve operations.
sections.description: Digital Transformation contributes application engineering, integration and quality evidence. Security validation is delivered with the Cyber Security portfolio.

plays.title: AI Code Assurance
plays.trigger: AI-written application changes need both functional and security checks.
plays.outcome: Start with a CI/CD assurance-gate map and a regression baseline. Agree release acceptance measures with the application owner.

plays.title: Modernisation & Programme Assurance
plays.trigger: Legacy dependencies and customisation make migration difficult to assess.
plays.outcome: Start with an application and integration dependency map. Use migration readiness and regression evidence to support release decisions.
plays.ip: Linkworks, Modernisation & Integration Toolkit, testoriumz, Release Assurance Packs

plays.title: Intelligent Operations
plays.trigger: Manual hand-offs slow processes and fragment customer conversations.
plays.outcome: Start with a workflow and exception map. Redesign and automate work, measuring the process outcomes agreed with its owner.
plays.ip: Linkworks, Intelligent Workflow Automation Framework, testoriumz, Cyber-Safe Delivery

sections.heading: Software for modernisation and *quality assurance*
sections.description: Use Linkfields software on its own or alongside specialist services.

items.title: Linkworks
items.description: Composable enterprise applications using microservices, REST APIs, composable UI, cloud-native engineering and DevSecOps. Use it for modernisation and integration where a standard application does not fit.

items.title: testoriumz
items.description: Continuous quality engineering with test management, low-code automation, AI root-cause analysis, dashboards and CI/CD integration. Use it to connect testing with release assurance.

items.title: Reusable delivery IP
items.description: Modernisation & Integration Toolkit, Automated Testing & Release Assurance Packs and Cyber-Safe Delivery support engineering and release work.

sections.noteLabel: Software and services are separate choices
sections.note: Products are available by licence, subscription or SaaS, with or without a Linkfields services engagement. Agree deployment, data handling and integration requirements for the selected offering.

sections.heading: From readiness to an assured release
sections.description: Illustrative engagement pattern: agree scope, owners and acceptance criteria before delivery.

items.title: Assess readiness
items.description: Map applications, interfaces, process constraints and release risk. Agree the modernisation scope and acceptance criteria.

items.title: Modernise and connect
items.description: Build or refactor applications, automate work and rebuild integrations. Review quality and security as changes progress.

items.title: Assure and hand over
items.description: Run regression and release checks, document operational responsibilities and plan ongoing improvement.

sections.note: Agree the test baseline, integration checks, outstanding defects, security findings and exception acceptance for release decisions. Commercials and product licensing are separate choices.
